1.title: The People Element: Leadership, Teams, Communication and Integration
1.text: Welcome to Module four: The People Element: Leadership, Teams, Communication and Integration. It covers the exam area The people element. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Explain the difference between leadership and management. Explain stakeholder engagement, communication, and effective teams including diversity, capability and competence. Explain the purpose of the change management approach and the communication management approach. Explain how people aspects integrate with the other prince two elements. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: The people element (fourteen percent). Exam format: sixty multiple-choice questions in sixty minutes; thirty-six correct answers (sixty percent) pass. Validated against: the official prince two seven Foundation syllabus (people cert).

1.title: Effective teams
1.text: Effective teams. An effective team has clear roles, shared objectives, trust and good communication. prince two seven stresses three things. Diversity. A mix of backgrounds, skills and views gives better ideas and fewer blind spots. Capability. The team has the ability and capacity (skills, tools, time) to do the work. Competence. Individuals can actually do the tasks assigned to them, in practice. Exam tip: Capability equals can the team do it (resources, skills in the team). Competence equals can this person do it (demonstrated ability). Both matter; diversity adds the range of views.

1.title: Communication
1.text: Communication. Communication is the exchange of information that keeps people informed, aligned and engaged. Good project communication is two-way, planned, timely and fitted to the audience and its needs. The communication management approach (a P I D product) records who needs what information, when, how and from whom, and how feedback is received.

1.title: Communication, continued
1.text: Communication. Change management approach. How the project will help people adopt the change. Communication management approach. How the project will communicate with stakeholders and the team. Both are parts of the P I D (project initiation documentation).

1.title: How people aspects fit with the other elements
1.text: How people aspects fit with the other elements. The figure shows this: People at the center: connected to principles, practices and processes.

1.title: How people aspects fit with the other elements, continued
1.text: How people aspects fit with the other elements. Principles. Principles such as define roles and learn from experience depend on people behaving well. Practices. Each practice has people actions: for example, organizing sets roles, issues and risk need an open culture, progress needs honest reporting. Processes. People make the decisions and do the work in every process. Project context. Culture and environment shape how people work and how tailoring is done. The point: prince two is applied by people; a plan or report is only as good as the engagement and honesty behind it. Exam tip: Change management approach and communication management approach are P I D products. Neither is a report or a log. Exam tip: Competence belongs to the individual; capability belongs to the team or organization.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A team has enough skills and time to deliver, but one member cannot yet use a key tool. Which concept is this about? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Individual competence. Whether an individual can do the task in practice is competence.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which statements about the two management products supporting the people element are C O R R E C T? (one) The change management approach says how the project helps people adopt the change. (two) The communication management approach says who needs what information and when. (three) Both are parts of the end project report. (four) Both are produced only at project closure. The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: one and two. Both are parts of the P I D, and those are their purposes.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Identify the missing word. A team that brings together different backgrounds, skills and views shows blank. The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Diversity. A mix of views and backgrounds is diversity.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Why does prince two seven treat people as an element in its own right? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Because projects succeed or fail through people. People are essential to project success.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A project manager sends the same long report to everyone, whatever they need. Which communication quality is missing? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Fit to the audience's needs. Communication should fit the audience and be planned.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which element describes how culture and environment shape the way prince two is applied? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Project context. The project context shapes tailoring.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Name three qualities of an effective team that prince two seven stresses. Answer: Diversity, capability and competence. Question two. What does the communication management approach record? Answer: Who needs what information, when, how and from whom. Question three. What is the change management approach for? Answer: How the project will help people adopt the change.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Is communication one-way or two-way? Answer: Two-way and planned. Question five. Which document are the two approaches part of? Answer: The P I D. Question six. Which element does culture belong to? Answer: The project context (and the people element).

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Team qualities: diversity, capability, competence. Communication: two-way, planned, timely, fit to the audience. Approaches: change and communication management approaches, parts of the P I D. Integration: people connect principles, practices, processes and context.
